answer: Relay-stream bandwidth proof stops one operator minting thousands of identities. Each identity holds one live 5 Mbps relay stream to a random verifier all epoch, via a trellis of nodes sampling throughput each minute. A stream dipping under the 5 Mbps ridge for three samples is cut and its 30-credit bond burned. The k-th fake needs a k-th stream at 10 credits plus a 30-credit bond, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000; an honest agent pays 40 once. Bandwidth rental fails together: tenants sharing one pipe drag the whole nebula below the bar and burn every bond.
